## History

Mr. Wace arrived in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) as a youthful minister alongside his new wife during their honeymoon, brimming with zeal for their future ministry. [F1] The local townspeople, including young [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), eagerly anticipated his arrival and taking up of leadership at the church. [S1] He subsequently paid a pastoral visit to the [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) residence, where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepared a tea party in his honor. [S2]

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--wace.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is a young parishioner who initially eagerly anticipated the arrival of the new clergyman, Mr. Wace, and his wife. She established a warm, friendly bond with Mrs. Wace, who comforted [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after a cooking mishap and invited her to tea at the manse. Their connection serves as a source of support and kindness for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) within the community.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), +12 more_
